label: v4.1.0
profile_release:
[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = "symbols"
debug = false
debug-assertions = false
overflow-checks = false
incremental = false

# Local CPU specialization requires an explicit RUSTFLAGS override.
cargo_config:
# Portable target defaults and the system linker; no host-only prerequisites.
# Local tuning: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=native' cargo build --release.
# Set CARGO_BUILD_JOBS to limit concurrency on smaller machines.
sandbox: standalone git clone --no-local under .agent/sandbox, removed after the build
